_comment: room_mcp configuration. State files live next to this file (ROOT-relative). Pool sizes are intentionally tiny here — they exist as schema examples. See PHILOSOPHY.md before filling them in.
_comment_city: Used by weather.py (wttr.in). Set to your city.
_comment_tz: IANA timezone name. Used to compute local time for the time/light layer.
_comment_scheduler_root: Path to the scheduler/ directory, relative to this config (or absolute). The renderer reads perturbation.json from here; set_next_wake writes schedule.json here.

season_terms._comment: Solar terms (二十四节气) — astronomical fact, not personal. Date strings are MM-DD.
season_terms.01-05: 小寒 (xiǎohán) — minor cold, deepest of winter coming.
season_terms.01-20: 大寒 (dàhán) — great cold, the year's coldest stretch.
season_terms.02-04: 立春 (lìchūn) — start of spring, though it doesn't feel like it yet.
season_terms.02-19: 雨水 (yǔshuǐ) — rain water, winter's grip loosens.
season_terms.03-06: 惊蛰 (jīngzhé) — insects wake, ground softens.
season_terms.03-20: 春分 (chūnfēn) — spring equinox, day equals night.
season_terms.04-05: 清明 (qīngmíng) — clear and bright, ancestor day.
season_terms.04-20: 谷雨 (gǔyǔ) — grain rain, planting season.
season_terms.05-21: 小满 (xiǎomǎn) — grain begins to fill out.
season_terms.06-05: 芒种 (mángzhòng) — bearded grain, harvest of wheat begins.
season_terms.06-21: 夏至 (xiàzhì) — summer solstice, longest day of the year.
season_terms.07-23: 大暑 (dàshǔ) — great heat, the year's hottest.
season_terms.08-07: 立秋 (lìqiū) — start of autumn — calendar autumn, even if it's still hot.
season_terms.09-07: 白露 (báilù) — white dew, mornings cool.
season_terms.12-21: 冬至 (dōngzhì) — winter solstice, shortest day.
